item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00197","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C14","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives first consider a more forceful or permanent institutional response, conclude that it is unnecessary or inappropriate \"at this time,\" and instead assign an existing agency to develop a peacetime or voluntary program. Each then requires cooperation with another defense-related body and closes by noting that a copy is being sent to the Secretary of Defense. C14 is also materially similar in assigning interagency leadership and requesting recommendations, including possible legislation, but its emergency-response posture is less closely aligned with the child's deliberate rejection of an operational program. C05 shares the disaster-relief subject and consideration of permanent arrangements but lacks the child's operative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Therefore, I see no need to establish at this time a permanent organization... Rather, I see a definite necessity to continue planning for civil defense","parent_excerpt":"For these reasons, therefore, I do not consider it appropriate to invoke the authority contained in section 18(h) at this time. Instead, I am asking you to proceed immediately to develop a voluntary allocations program","explanation":"Both use the same decision pattern: reject a stronger institutional or mandatory mechanism for the present and substitute a planning or voluntary program administered through existing authority."},{"child_excerpt":"I have concluded that the National Security Resources Board... is the appropriate agency which should also exercise leadership in civil defense planning.","parent_excerpt":"It is highly desirable that all governmental operations relating to allocations of steel be concentrated in a single agency...","explanation":"Both identify an existing agency as the locus for coordinating a broader program rather than creating or activating a separate mechanism."},{"child_excerpt":"the Board will undoubtedly find it necessary and advisable to call upon the other agencies of the Government","parent_excerpt":"It will be necessary, of course, for your office to work in the closest possible cooperation with the National Military Establishment","explanation":"Each anticipates interagency cooperation as part of program development and execution."},{"child_excerpt":"I am sending a copy of this memorandum to the Secretary of Defense","parent_excerpt":"A copy of this letter is being sent to the Secretary of Defense.","explanation":"The nearly identical closing notification is especially probative when combined with the parallel substantive sequence."}]}
